description: Defines classes and functions for capturing and replaying OpenGL frame data, including parameter and call capture, within the ANGLE project.

classes.name: ParamCapture
classes.description: Represents a captured parameter with its name, type, value, and associated data.

classes.name: ParamBuffer
classes.description: Stores a collection of parameter captures for a single call.

classes.name: CallCapture
classes.description: Represents a captured OpenGL call with its associated parameters.

classes.name: ReplayContext
classes.description: Provides context for replaying captured calls, managing buffers and pointers.

classes.name: FrameCapture
classes.description: Manages capturing and replaying of frame data, including setup, frame, and teardown calls.

methods.name: captureCall
methods.description: Records a captured call into the frame capture system.

methods.name: onEndFrame
methods.description: Signals the end of a frame for capturing purposes.

methods.name: enabled
methods.description: Checks if frame capturing is enabled.

methods.name: replay
methods.description: Replays the captured frame data.

methods.name: captureClientArraySnapshot
methods.description: Captures the current state of client arrays.

methods.name: reset
methods.description: Resets the frame capture state.

methods.name: maybeCaptureClientData
methods.description: Conditionally captures client data based on the call.

methods.name: ReplayCall
methods.description: Static method to replay a specific call.

methods.name: CaptureCallToFrameCapture
methods.description: Template function to capture a call and add it to the frame capture.

methods.name: addValueParam
methods.description: Template method to add a value parameter to the capture.

methods.name: addEnumParam
methods.description: Template method to add an enum parameter to the capture.

methods.name: getReadBufferPointer
methods.description: Template method to get a pointer from the read buffer.

methods.name: getAsConstPointer
methods.description: Template method to get a constant pointer from a parameter.

methods.name: getAsPointerConstPointer
methods.description: Template method to get a pointer-to-pointer from a parameter.

methods.name: CaptureMemory
methods.description: Helper to capture memory data into a parameter.

methods.name: CaptureString
methods.description: Helper to capture a string into a parameter.

methods.name: GetLinkedProgramForCapture
methods.description: Retrieves a linked program for capture purposes.

methods.name: CaptureGetParameter
methods.description: Captures the value of a GL parameter.

methods.name: CaptureGenHandles
methods.description: Captures generated handle IDs.

methods.name: WriteParamValueToStream
methods.description: Serializes a parameter value to an output stream.
